sloka: मौक्तिका मणयः स्निग्धा वज्रं चापि प्रवालकम्।क्षौमं च दह्यते तत्र कौशेयं चापि शोभनम् ।। ६.७५.८ ।।
transliteration: mauktikā maṇayaḥ snigdhā vajraṁ cāpi pravālakam।kṣaumaṁ ca dahyate tatra kauśeyaṁ cāpi śobhanam ।। 6.75.8 ।।

translations.english: There, in Lanka, incense and the best of sandalwood was burnt. Nay even glossy pearls, gems and diamonds were also burnt.
